name: DeepAnalyze
description: Agentic LLM for autonomous data science that plans, writes and runs analysis code and produces analyst-style reports.
whatItDoes: Carries out the full data science loop on uploaded files, from preparation and analysis to modelling, visualisation and a written report. It targets researchers and analysts who want a locally hosted model rather than a cloud API.
howItWorks: An 8B open-weight model trained for agentic data work is served through vLLM with an OpenAI-style API. Bundled chat, API server and CLI demos send it tasks and execute the code it emits against the workspace files.

requirements.name: GPU
requirements.description: Roughly 16 GB of GPU memory or more to serve the model, depending on quantisation
